_readme: English datasheet-header -> field_key map, for the WP3 deep extractor.
Separate from attribute-aliases.de.json because that one maps HexCat's authored GERMAN
attribute names; this one maps Cisco's own English table labels.
Rules are ORDERED REGEXES, not exact strings, because shape-C labels carry a qualifier in
brackets ('Dimensions (H x W x D) in inches [Chassis only]') and shape-A headers vary in
wording between datasheet generations. First match wins, so specific patterns come first:
'Switching capacity with stacking' must be matched before 'Switching capacity'.
Sentinels behave as in the German map. Two are specific to this side:
__duplicate_unit : the same fact in a second unit (inches alongside centimetres, pounds
alongside kilograms). Dropped deliberately - storing both would double
count the field and inflate completeness.
__backlog        : a real spec with no field_key yet; a NAMED gap, reported not guessed.
